assessment.body:
## Verdict

agent_supports: yes
daemon_capability: full
driver_capability: ready

## Reasoning

A provider refuses a turn because the quota is used up. On 2.x the refusal is terminal and classified: probed with the repo's mock-openai-429 (HTTP 403 `insufficient_quota`, which the AI SDK does not retry — /Users/factory/.oc2sb/qa/p5b2-work/probe/2-9-mock.log), the turn ended at once with an `idle` row, outcome `failed`, error `{type: provider.quota, status: 403, message: "You exceeded your current quota…"}`. parser_v2.go turns a failed idle into SessionError (v2SessionError: class = the error's type), the plugin forwards `session.execution.failed` (a Stop hook), and the classifier routes a turn that ended in failure to the error state.

## Recipe

Turn 1 runs on the sandbox's own Kolibri model; the `model` step then moves the session to a mock provider whose every request is refused with mock-openai-429's exact quota body (the repo's mock-openai-error, flags below), so turn 2 hits the exhausted quota — a quota that runs out mid-session.

Why not mock-openai-429 itself (one success, then 403): its one success goes to whichever request lands first, and 2.x sends side requests beside a turn's. The first recording of this cell (/Users/factory/.oc2sb/qa/p5b2-work/2-9-first-run-evidence.txt, not promoted) lost it to a session title re-requested on the mock at turn 2 (the title read `Ok`, the mock's answer), so turn 2 failed instead of turn 3. That run's config also gave the mock model an 8192-token context, below the session's history, and 2.x compacted automatically before each mock turn; the context is now 131072, as Kolibri's.

## Wire check

The final per-cell config, with every provider's baseURL pointed at a local capture stub (/Users/factory/.oc2sb/qa/p5b2-work/probe/wire-2-9-final.log): the title and turn 1 named the Kolibri path (the sandbox's kolibri provider), turn 2 named `mock-quota-model`. No request names any other model.
caveats: An instant refusal leaves the turn almost no time in working: the first recording showed ready → working → error inside one millisecond on the hook's pass. The spec pins the error and what follows, not a working phase for the refused turn.

The repo's mock-openai-error running at 127.0.0.1:18766 for the whole run, refusing every request with mock-openai-429's quota body: --addr 127.0.0.1:18766 --status 403 --error-type insufficient_quota --error-code insufficient_quota --error-message 'You exceeded your current quota, please check your plan and billing details.' It serves the mock provider's turn, so it never reaches the local model. Build: go build -o .build/refresh/bin/mock-openai-error ./tools/onboarding-factory/recording/mock-openai-error/
setup: driver-interactive.sh (API driver) refuses before creating anything unless exactly one `serve --service` runs, its environment carries the run's XDG_* values, and the plugin's beacon resolves this run's daemon

It creates one session over POST /api/session at <staging>/cwd, waits for the service log to show the plugin the daemon installed loading for that location with no load failure, then drives the script; the session's session_message rows are exported read-only as the transcript
mock provider `mockquota` declared in RUN_CWD/opencode.json (baseURL 127.0.0.1:18766); the session starts on the sandbox's default Kolibri model; the shell is denied
turn 1 on Kolibri, then the model step to mockquota/mock-quota-model, then turn 2 (refused: 403 insufficient_quota)
